checks: Both half-widths interpolate affinely, so the exact midpoint identity holds for the rectangles and their common unit-thickness products. Direct integration gives masses 16,25,16 and density one.

At an interior mark, radialization of density one is the translate K_z−c, whose centroid vanishes only at c=0. Boundary and exterior marks cannot yield a full-dimensional zero-centroid radial body due to a separating support direction.

The power is 1/3−1/2=−1/6; hence endpoint midpoint 16^(-1/6)K_0 strictly contains 25^(-1/6)K_0. Linear projection of a purported midpoint inclusion preserves Minkowski addition and inclusion, contradicting the explicit projected obstruction.

The mixed four-volume is 57ε_j²; exp(j)>j⁴/24>57j for j≥12 ensures the level is inside the slab. Substitution u=ε_j w cancels 1/ε_j and gives the common-normalization limits with the correct unit rectangular density.

overlap.comparison: The related accepted single-cell example has atomic limits and no mass-root rescaling of nonhomothetic projected convex bodies. Here the unscaled marginals already satisfy exact midpoint inclusion.

readability: The normalizing power acts on the shape before any auxiliary lift.
